# vvm_network (Resource)

A VVM guest network (`/v1/networks`): a VLAN on a cluster, the subnet guests take their addresses from, and the IPAM range VVM hands out of it.

`terraform apply` returns when the control plane reports the network `Active` — the point at which a VM may be put on it. Every attribute is immutable: a change destroys and recreates.

⛔ A guest CIDR that contains a host's own address, or the address a file share is mounted from, is refused by the control plane (it would take the host off the network). Pick a range the cluster does not already use.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vvm_network" "app" {
  cluster_id       = var.cluster_id
  name             = "app-net"
  vlan_id          = 105
  vpc_subnet_id    = var.vpc_subnet_id
  cidr             = "10.249.0.0/24"
  ipam_range_start = "10.249.0.10"
  ipam_range_end   = "10.249.0.50"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cidr` (String) The guest subnet in CIDR form, e.g. `10.242.0.0/24`.
- `cluster_id` (String) UUID of the cluster this network belongs to.
- `ipam_range_end` (String) Last address VVM may assign to a guest. Must be inside `cidr`.
- `ipam_range_start` (String) First address VVM may assign to a guest. Must be inside `cidr`.
- `name` (String) Name of the network.
- `vlan_id` (Number) VLAN id. Unique within the cluster: a second network with the same `vlan_id` on the same cluster is refused.
- `vpc_subnet_id` (String) Id of the IBM Cloud VPC subnet this network sits on — reference an `ibm_is_subnet` built by the IBM provider rather than managing it here.

### Optional

- `create_timeout` (String) How long `terraform apply` waits for this resource to reach its target state, as a Go duration (e.g. `45m`). Default `20m`. On timeout the error carries the state the control plane last reported and the state of the job behind it.
- `delete_timeout` (String) How long `terraform destroy` waits for this resource to be gone, as a Go duration. Default `20m`.
- `ovn_logical_switch_id` (String) Existing OVN logical switch to adopt. Omit to let VVM make one.

### Read-Only

- `actual_state` (String) The state the control plane has OBSERVED, reconciled against reality. `terraform plan` shows a change here when the network was changed outside Terraform.
- `desired_state` (String) The state the control plane is working towards.
- `id` (String) UUID the control plane minted for this network.
- `job_id` (String) The asynchronous job the create emitted. Named in the error when a create or a delete runs out of time, so the real job state is what the operator sees.
- `updated_at` (String) When the row last changed, as the API reported it. Used as the `If-Match` precondition on a delete; it is re-read immediately before the delete is sent, because the row's timestamp moves on its own.
